Ranks all Montgomery census tracts by total 2025 311 service request counts, left-joining tract counts to tract names so zero-count tracts appear with 0, ordered by count descending then name, with geoid last for mapping.
sql:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT geoid, n AS request_count
  FROM fw_pg.tract_counts
  WHERE run_id = 'r_20261025_a5f032'
    AND source = 'm1_city'
    AND grp = 'all'
)
SELECT t.name,
       COALESCE(c.request_count, 0) AS request_count,
       t.geoid
FROM fw_pg.tracts t
LEFT JOIN counts c ON t.geoid = c.geoid
ORDER BY request_count DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 200
